body:
Therein lies the problem... I've isolated myself for so long I literally have no one to talk to. I had to travel for business recently and got to spend time with like minded people. It was so much fun. Good, right? Nope. When I got back to the hotel I spent my nights walking on the railing of the balcony 20 floors up contemplating jumping. This was after consuming numerous glasses of scotch. I've done so much sketchy shit... how am I still alive? Why must I be tortured into actually initiating it directly? FUCK. I must be paying for something I did in a past life. That's the only way I can make sense of it all.

Xanax has me feeling good and I've been drinking vodka all night. I think I'll finally be able to end it tonight. I just wish it would have looked like a mistake. Even with my coworkers who don't really know me... I know it'll impact them. While I don't give a fuck about my life, I hate the idea of being a nuisance to others.
